definitions: To leave someone to take the blame or responsibility for a problem or failure, often unfairly, while others escape consequences.
To abandon someone in a difficult situation, leaving them to deal with the repercussions alone.
examples: When the project failed, the manager left his junior colleague holding the bag.
They all ran off, leaving me holding the bag for the mess.
She felt she was left holding the bag after her partners pulled out of the deal.
